chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 567: The Godking's Bargain - A Soul-Trapping Nightmare
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is offered a choice: join the Seamless Gate and keep Yu Wei, or condemn her to an eternity of hellfire. The Godking's ultimate trap is sprung.
og_title: Desolate Era: Chapter 567 - The Soul-Shattering Choice
og_description: Ji Ning learns his beloved is alive, trapped as a bargaining chip in the Godking's game of souls.
twitter_description: Peace or hell? The Seamless Gate's master gambit.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme leader of the Seamless Gate and master of dreams, capable of pulling cultivators' consciousness into his own world.
The eighth major realm of Ki Refining, a being of perfect, unchanging yang energy.
The fundamental, indestructible core of a being's identity, distinct from the scattered soul. Its destruction is true oblivion.
A metaphysical river containing the truesouls of all beings; only a supreme power like Mother Nuwa can retrieve a soul from it.
A localized, man-made version of the Six Paths of Reincarnation that a Daofather can use to send a soul for rebirth.
A personal realm of torment created by the Godking, worse than the traditional eighteen levels of hell.
One of the Three Sovereigns of Humanity, a cosmic power whose alchemical medicine can cripple immortal ki.
A supreme cultivator who has mastered a Heavenly Dao, the highest level of power in the Three Realms.
The Nuwa camp's primary mobile fortress and command center in the Realm War.
A mysterious, powerful figure from the Nuwa camp who intervened to save Ji Ning from an earlier assassination attempt.
